items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Everybody. Jack Lee, every nationality. Lost the insurance company.

ctx.x: I was just going to ask if you think more people today belong to insurance or to clubs. I mean, do you think?

Well, you could tell from all the insurance. Look at the insurance they have. Look at the building they got now. Whose money is there? And look at the insurance. Just imagine the insurance you got. You ever take a take there. You're going to find out something. Take the talks. I'm going to phone the book. You see the clubs and all the insurance. See. And there's more members in there. There's thousands of thousands of people. Why do you call it? Everybody. Jack Lee, every nationality. Lost the insurance company.…
I wanted to ask you something about a banque. Uh-huh. Oh yeah. Who would give a banque?
